definitions.explanation: A telecommunications or internet line; the physical or virtual connection used for data transmission or phone calls.

examples.japanese: {回線|かいせん}が{混|こ}んでいてつながらない。
examples.english: The line is congested and I can't get through.

examples.japanese: {光回線|ひかりかいせん}に{切|き}り{替|か}えたら{速度|そくど}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Speed improved after switching to a fiber-optic line.

examples.japanese: {災害時|さいがいじ}は{電話回線|でんわかいせん}がパンクして、{連絡|れんらく}が{取|と}れなくなることがある。
examples.english: During disasters, phone lines can become overloaded and it may become impossible to reach people.

notes:
USAGE:
{回線|かいせん} is used for both telephone lines and internet connections. It is a common term in everyday life when discussing internet service, phone contracts, or network issues.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {光回線|ひかりかいせん} (fiber-optic line)
- {電話回線|でんわかいせん} (telephone line)
- {回線|かいせん}{速度|そくど} (line speed)
- {回線|かいせん}が{混|こ}む (the line is congested)
- {回線|かいせん}を{契約|けいやく}する (to contract a line/connection)

HOMOPHONE NOTE:
Not to be confused with {海鮮|かいせん} (seafood), which has the same reading.
